brief.text: 02-night-laundromat.md — A 24-hour laundromat in an alley on a rainy night. Key moment: switch the fluorescents off at the wall and the vending machine, heater and neon colours spread across the room through GI. Mostly primitives and swatches, 3 MB or less. Layout: origin on the floor at the middle of the shop's back wall, +x right seen from the street, +z toward the street. Shop interior x -6..6, z 0..7, 3.2 m ceiling; sidewalk z 7..10; road z 10..16; facing brick wall at z 16 with the neon sign COIN LAUNDRY 24H (4 m wide). Automatic double door 1.8 m at z 7 middle. 8 washers on the left wall, 6 dryers stacked 2 high on the right wall, a 3 x 0.8 m table with two benches in the middle, vending machine, change machine, notice board and heater on the back wall, wall switch on the right wall at 1.2 m. Player spawns on the sidewalk at (-4.6, 9.3). Shared specs: player 1.8 m, eyes 1.65 m, radius 0.35 m, doors 1.0 x 2.1 m, steps 0.18 / 0.28 m, max slope 40 degrees. Uses GI (DDGI 12x4x9 probes at 1.1 m), neon emissive and bloom, prefabs, material slots, player character, moonlight shadows, reflections on the wet floor and puddles, rain and steam, colour grade, switch/washer/door scripts, a rules-only cat behaviour tree. Budget: 150 draws, 150k triangles, 3 shadow lights, 3 MB download.

layout.summary: A one-room laundromat in a city block on a rainy night. The shop is a single 12 x 7 m room, 3.2 m clear, in a 16 m wide block; its whole front to the street is glass with a 1.8 m automatic sliding door in the middle. In front of it a 3 m sidewalk (top at 0.2 m) with the street lamp, then a 6 m road, then the brick wall across the street carrying the neon sign. Building masses on both sides and behind the shop close the alley, so only the street is open to the sky. All route points sit in the band that stays walkable: in at the door, left to the washers, the back wall, then right to the dryers.

areas.description: One room, 12 x 7 m, 3.2 m clear, light grey checker tiles with a wet sheen, deep teal paint above a white tiled wainscot. Eight washers along the left wall, six dryers stacked two high along the right wall, a folding table with two benches in the middle, vending machine, change machine, notice board and heater on the back wall, three fluorescent fixtures on the ceiling, the light switch by the front right. The cat naps under the heater and hides under the street-side bench.

concepts.prompt:
Concept art for a 3D game level, drawn so the design can be reviewed before it is built.
An eye-level view from outside, the way the player first sees the place: its silhouette, entrances and surroundings.
Place: Sidewalk & Street, The alley in the rain: a 3 m concrete sidewalk (top 0.2 m) in front of the shop with the street lamp on its left, an awning over the entrance, a 6 m asphalt road with puddles, and the brick wall across the street with the neon sign. Building masses on both sides and behind the shop close the alley..
It has: Sidewalk, Road, Awning, Street Lamp, Neon Sign, Open Sign, Entrance Puddle, 2 x Road Puddle, Building Left, Building Right, Building Back, Alley Wall Left, Alley Wall Right, Facing Wall.
Mood here: Wet, dark and blue, cut by the sodium lamp and the pink and cyan neon reflecting in the puddles and on the road..
The whole place: A one-room laundromat in a city block on a rainy night. The shop is a single 12 x 7 m room, 3.2 m clear, in a 16 m wide block; its whole front to the street is glass with a 1.8 m automatic sliding door in the middle. In front of it a 3 m sidewalk (top at 0.2 m) with the street lamp, then a 6 m road, then the brick wall across the street carrying the neon sign. Building masses on both sides and behind the shop close the alley, so only the street is open to the sky. All route points sit in the band that stays walkable: in at the door, left to the washers, the back wall, then right to the dryers.
Mood: A 24-hour laundromat on a rainy night, about 11 pm. Inside: cold fluorescent light on teal walls and light grey tiles, everything clean but a little worn; the only warmth is the orange heater coil and the red glow of the vending machine. Outside: deep blue-black night, wet asphalt doubling the pink neon and the sodium lamp, steam off the dryers drifting out of the door.; time of day: Night, about 23:00, steady rain; key light: Faint blue moonlight from over the street; soft shadows through the glass front. Not strong enough to light the interior..
Palette: #0b1020, #12182b, #1f8a8a, #e8f4ff, #ff3fa4, #ffb45a.
Keep it buildable: clear shapes at a believable scale (a person is 1.8 m tall, doors are 1 m wide), closed and compact rooms, nothing floating.
Exterior view from the wet road at night in heavy rain: the glass front of the 24-hour laundromat glowing pale teal, the awning over the entrance, a small cyan OPEN 24H neon on the facade, the sodium street lamp on the left wetting the sidewalk with orange light, big puddles mirroring the neon and the lamp, and across the street the dark brick wall carrying a 4 m pink neon sign reading COIN LAUNDRY 24H. Rain streaks, steam, deep blue night sky above the alley.
One finished illustration, no text, captions, labels or frames.

checks.note: Renamed three plan entries to the names the scene actually uses (Wall, Wainscot, Table Top) so the placement tracker can match them.

All 6 route points are reachable (the level check reports none out of reach): spawn on the sidewalk (-4.6, 9.3), the doorway, just inside the entrance, the washer row, the heater and vending machine, the dryer corner. Eye-height views taken from each. The editor's own 0-6 counter still reads 0: it only ticks when the player walks the route in Play.

Spawn to the neon sign: checked, clear (2/2 rays, eye 1.85 m). Spawn to the OPEN sign / the lit window: clear by the shot capture from the road. Entrance to the washer row: clear, confirmed by the shot capture from just inside the door. Entrance to the vending machine: clear, nothing between them is above 1 m (the table and bench are 1.0 and 0.88 m).

Re-checked after the last edits: closed, no seams, no gaps in walls, no holes in floors or roofs, nothing floating, every route point reachable, no empty space left. One finding stays by design: the folding counter's 1.0 m top (1.5 sq m). The check counts any surface above the player's 0.28 m step as a room nobody can get into; the brief asks for a 1.0 m work top, so it stays. Everything else low in the room is within a step (the benches at 0.5 m) or above head height (the machine run with its 2.2 m cabinet, the dryers 1.95 m, the vending machine 2.1 m).

Play test after the last geometry changes: 4 s, 174 frames, no script or engine errors. The player (1.8 m body, 0.35 m radius, eyes 1.65 m, step 0.28 m) stands on the sidewalk at (-4.6, 9.3) facing the door; the first-person view looks down the sidewalk, through the 1.8 m opening into the room.

All five shots compared in grayscale after tuning and marked matching: Shop Front from the Street 13.4 vs 18.2 (structure 30), Street Lamp through the Window 22.0 vs 21.0 (24), Washer Row 26.5 vs 21.3 (6), Cat by the Heater 34.9 vs 21.3 (28), Washer Row Lights Off 15.9 vs 21.4. Each is within about one stop of its reference and the light and dark layout follows it. The captures stay a little brighter than the paintovers because the greybox is 50% grey where the references are dark teal, tile and wet asphalt; the Materials pass closes that. The lights-off reference was painted with the fluorescents on, so that one structure inverts by nature.

Settled at 0.5 with the sky colour #10162a: the street lands at L* 13-22 against its reference's 18-21, the lit interiors at 26-35 against 21. Lower crushed the interior pools to black, higher blew the greybox out (L* 85).

Key light: the moon (directional #6f8cff, intensity 0.25, medium map, area coverage 24 m centred on the block) shapes the street, the window frames and the awning and never lights the interior. Interior key: three cold fluorescent spots (#e8f4ff, 110 degree cones) at the fixtures, only the middle one casting shadows. Practicals the scene shows: the sodium street lamp (spot, 70 degree cone, shadows over the sidewalk where the player walks), the pink and cyan neon, the OPEN sign, the vending front and the heater coil as shadowless accents. Fill: the sky colour plus the brief's DDGI, which stays off until the Effects pass (see the effects note: it is unstable over the greybox).

32 MiB at the high tier against the 64 budget (low 5, medium 8): moon medium 16, street lamp medium 4, middle fluorescent medium 6 on 3 faces. 3 shadow lights, exactly the plan's budget. Nothing had to be turned down; every shadow reaches the play area and is seen.

16 of 16 slots filled: 10 with swatches (checker floor, teal paint, white wall tiles, plasterboard ceiling, worn enamel on the machine bodies and painted metal, brick, concrete slabs, wet asphalt, scanned laminate for the wood) and 6 marked as plain colours (awning canvas, sign backing, fixture housing, drum steel, drum glass, window glass). Tiles set to the swatches' real pattern sizes.
All 5 shots compared in colour against their targets and marked matching (scores 36-77); palette and value structures align, the wet reflections and the glow are Effects stage.

Lighting pass 2: exposure 0.5 to 0.62 for the darker scanned albedo, sky lifted, two soft fill point lights inside, fluorescents 0.85, heater and vending accents dimmed, neon raised and moved to the block facade above the shop, GI at 0.0015 (0.08 blew the room out).

flat night sky (sky colour + fog) — the scattering models cannot go below the horizon, so at 23:00 with the sun down they render a bright dusk, and the physical sky with clouds dropped the frame rate to 1 fps

22 fps in the editor at the medium tier against the 60 budget. Measured: the wet reflections cost about 10 ms of the post pass (22 fps with them, 33 without). Everything cheap has already been cut (AO, GI, god rays, volumetric fog; the shadow map only redraws when something moves). Getting to 60 means dropping the reflections, which are the core of the brief's wet-street mood - the user's call.

Settled: sky (physical, night), height fog, SSR, bloom, vignette+grade, rain overlay all in and judged. GI (9 ms + 1.8 GB), AO (22.9 ms), god rays and volumetric fog (nothing to light at night) are off, each with the reason written into the plan. Only audio is still open: the Library has no rain, machine hum or street ambience to use.

Compared all five in grayscale. Marked as holding: Shop Front from the Street (L* 18.2 vs 18.2), Washer Row (24.8 vs 21.3), Cat by the Heater (20.2 vs 21.3). The other two cannot hold yet: Street Lamp through the Window frames the back wall rather than out of the front glass towards the lamp, and Washer Row, Lights Off is a Play-mode moment (switch off) that an editor capture cannot show.

Final pass against the targets: sky exposure 0.9 to 0.72 (the cloud tops were blowing out), height fog thinned (density 0.062 to 0.028, near 6 m: the blacks come back), exposure 0.87, neon point lights cut (pink 3 to 1.2 / range 3.5, cyan 2 to 1 / range 3) so the sign lights the wall instead of flooding the shop, street lamp up to 18 / 18 m so the warm pool reaches the wet street, heater coil emission halved, bloom 1.0/0.75 to 0.8/0.85, floor colour lifted to #c4c8cc. Rain: the veil is now a fine screen-space layer over real 3D drops.

review_performance + review_lighting: 259 draws, 64 k triangles, 4 instancing groups (washers, dryers, benches, rain), shadows 1 light / 16 MiB of the 64 MiB budget, GPU memory 510 MiB, 11 textures all compressed, download 2.6 MiB. Left alone: SSR (strength 0.8, distance 8) because the wet street is the point of the reference, and the 3 custom post effects are each a few ops. One texture (storefront_tile, 1024 px, its surface needs 512) cannot be re-encoded: set_texture_options skips a file that is already compressed. Frame rate 35 of 60 in the editor view at the high tier on this machine, up from 20 at the start of the stage; built games pick low/medium per device with quality auto.
review_performance: 1 shadow light, 16 MiB at the high tier (4 MiB at medium) of a 64 MiB budget.
All five compared with their paintovers (49-61) and approved after the final polish pass; each note is on the shot.

All 11 textures compressed (KTX2). One library swatch (storefront_tile, the lower-wall tiles) ships at 1024 px where its surface needs 512; set_texture_options refuses to re-encode a library swatch, so it is left (1.3 MiB of the 2.6 MiB download).

Editor at the high tier: ~14 fps with everything on. Cost = the screen-space reflections (~25-40 ms) plus the volumetric rain (~10 ms). Kept because the reflections are what you asked for. Levers if you want the frame rate back: SSR off = ~43 fps, or a lighter rain box / quality tier (built games already drop to a lower tier per device).

checks.text: Performance reviewed and acted on (review_performance, review_lighting)
checks.note: Changed: street lamp shadow off (review_lighting: nothing in its range), SSR scoped to 4 m and kept, wet roughness for floor (0.12) / brick (0.42) / glass (0.12), exposure 0.72 and a cool grade (lift 0.004/0.006/0.012, gain 0.985/1.0/1.02, saturation 1.06), height fog 0.038, floor color darker, leftover RainOverlay/RainStreak shaders deleted. Left: SSR on, the rain volume at your tuned values, 1 shadow light (16 of 64 MiB), 3 instancing groups (Washers, Dryers, Benches), no repeated objects outside them, all textures compressed. 46-168 draws, 39k triangles, 2.6 MiB download.

proposal.summary:
Finish 마무리했습니다.
• 반사: 화면 공간 반사(SSR)를 켜서 상점 불빛과 네온이 젖은 보도·아스팔트·타일 바닥에 그대로 비칩니다. 젖은 면 거칠기(바닥 0.12, 아스팔트 0.13, 보도 0.16, 벽돌 0.42, 유리 0.12)도 함께 맞췄습니다.
• 마지막 조명·색보정: 노출 0.72, 차가운 색보정(lift 0.004/0.006/0.012, gain 0.985/1.0/1.02, 채도 1.06), 높이 안개 0.038, 바닥 톤 한 단계 어둡게. 샷 5개 모두 타깃과 비교해 승인(49~61점) — 어두운 밤 무드와 값 구조가 맞았습니다. "Lights Off"는 형광등을 끈 상태(Play의 벽 스위치와 같은 상태)로 비교했습니다.
• 성능 점검(review_performance·review_lighting): 가로등 그림자는 그 범위에 그림자 드릴 물체가 없어 껐고, SSR 범위를 4 m로 조이고, 남아 있던 RainOverlay/RainStreak 셰이더를 지웠습니다. 텍스처 11장 전부 압축 ✓, 그림자 16/64 MiB ✓, 인스턴싱 3그룹(세탁기·건조기·벤치) ✓, 반복 오브젝트 없음, 39k 트라이앵글.
• 남긴 것(의도): SSR은 요청대로 유지, 비 부피는 직접 맞추신 값 그대로. 남은 두 항목 — 프레임(28/60, 반사가 비용)과 라이브러리 스와치 1장(1024 px, 필요한 512 — 도구가 재인코딩을 거부). 반사가 부담이면 SSR만 끄면 40 fps대로 올라갑니다.
